description: Layout streams after layout/slice_routed.gds was re-generated with the pin-geometry layer-map fix (issue #149) and layout/lane_column.gds was re-assembled to embed it; re-attestation of attest/item2.r7.json, kept as history. Only the DEF->GDS merge changed: the staged KLayout LEF/DEF layer map now also sends each top-level DEF PINS rectangle to its metal's drawing purpose, so the pin's own name label coincides with a conductor and `klt lvs` can extract it. Placement and routing are unchanged (same netlist, same seed, route_drc_violation_count 0, antenna_violation_count 0, clock skew 0.00771 ns in layout/pnr/slice.pnr.report.json). Pinned by sha256 of raw bytes: the assembled column and its inputs (routed slice, drawn TX/RX cells). Layout geometry only; the DRC result is the separate record under verification/drc/ and is not re-measured here, and the LVS results are the separate records under evidence/item4-lvs/ (spec section 3). ASAP7 is predictive and nothing here is fabricated.

assembled.note: Re-assembled with `python3 layout/assemble_column.py` so the column embeds this slice stream; `--check` exits 0. The drawn TX/RX cells are unchanged, so only the embedded slice geometry moved.

pad_check.note: Re-run against the re-assembled column: status pass, 34/34 pad centres matched, layout/pad_check_record.json byte-identical to r7's. The pad layer (96/0) lives in the drawn cells, which this change does not touch.

generator.note: The routed slice is reproducible from the committed netlist and the pinned lambdapdk archive; `--check` reproduces it byte-for-byte.

envelope.note: The klt-produced envelope the block manifest cites for item 2; this file is the companion stream inventory.
